Thanks Kimberly / Jill —

Short answer: consolidation is doable but requires coordination with AWSOps. Operational notes:
- If Acme wants a single PO covering all 4 BU accounts, we need to pick a lead marketplace account to host the consolidated private offer (AWS requires a single seller-side PO/per private-offer id).
- AWS typically processes an amended private offer within 3 business days once the private-offer id and PO are submitted, but if we create a brand new consolidated private offer there is a 5–7 business day lead time in peak windows.
- Content we need from Acme: exact marketplace account IDs (the four buyer AWS account IDs), current private-offer ids or PO numbers, and whether the BU owners will accept a single invoice.
- Pricing: changing from 36 months to 12 months will typically increase the per-unit price. I ran a quick calc — if we shift to 12 months we should expect a ~7–12% uplift depending on reserved pricing tiers. I’ll confirm exact numbers once Rafael confirms the pricing tier mapping.

Action for Redwood: I’ll open an AWSOps ticket today and mark this as expedited if you confirm that DocuSign must be ready by 1/14.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
